edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails

  Scenario: AC5 Business rules BR1 to BR10 hold
    Given the rule list of section 8 is the rule list of this story
    When the step runs
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 of section 8 holds as written

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call does not answer inside 2 s
    Given the rwb-document contract mock does not answer inside 2 s
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "AWARD_PENDING" for "RC-2027-000611"
    When award confirmed
    Then nothing is written, no case move is answered, the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope and the step retries on the workflow's own schedule

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call fails
    Given the rwb-document contract mock returns no reference for the sale agreement of lot "LOT-2027-000041"
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "AWARD_PENDING" for "RC-2027-000611"
    When award confirmed
    Then nothing changes, no case move is answered, the agreement request is retried on the workflow's schedule and the award stays in AWARD_PENDING

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "BIDS_RECEIVED" for "RC-2027-000611"
    When award confirmed
    Then 409 is answered, nothing is written and the step is not re-evaluated
